claims.claim_text: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration to advance Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion.
claims.excerpt: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure — using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ to bring together NVIDIA’s open infrastructure platform

claims.claim_text: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 NPUs to the NVIDIA platform and use the NVIDIA MGX rack architecture for rack-scale system development.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units (NPUs) to the NVIDIA platform, and harness the NVIDIA MGX™ rack architecture for rack-scale system development.

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom plans to deploy the resulting systems in its AI data center using the MGX rack architecture.
claims.excerpt: SK Telecom plans to connect these capabilities and deploy them in its AI data center using the standardized MGX rack architecture to deliver full-stack sovereign AI.

claims.claim_text: Rebellions' R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions’ R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.

claims.claim_text: The companies plan to develop disaggregated inference, using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve throughput and power efficiency.
claims.excerpt: Their planned work includes using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.

claims.claim_text: Rebellions says its R200 NPU is optimized for low-latency, energy-efficient inference with frontier models, including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions is developing its next-generation R200 NPU, optimized for low-latency and energy-efficient inference using frontier models, including multitrillion-parameter mixture-of-experts models.

claims.claim_text: Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT is supporting the collaboration, beginning with Rebellions and SK Telecom, between NVIDIA and Korean NPU companies.
claims.excerpt: MSIT is supporting collaboration between NVIDIA and Korean NPU companies, beginning with Rebellions and SK Telecom, to strengthen Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure.

claims.claim_text: NVIDIA says NVLink Fusion lets chipmakers combine custom silicon with NVIDIA's scale-up networking and ecosystem, helping improve performance, reduce deployment risk and accelerate time to market.
claims.excerpt: helping improve performance, reduce deployment risk and accelerate time to market.

claims.claim_text: Jensen Huang said NVLink Fusion lets Korea's chipmakers connect custom ASICs to NVIDIA's AI factory platform.
claims.excerpt: With NVLink Fusion, Korea’s chipmakers can connect their custom ASICs to NVIDIA’s AI factory platform, tightly coupling their processors with NVIDIA compute to run AI workloads.
